title: Mental Health Worker
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

outcomes: Student use personal and professional communication appropriate to the client's developmental age, educational level, communication style, and cultural/ethnic identify.

Students employ basic documentation of client care and care coordination.Students engage in problem solving that will lead to the client's desired outcome. Student differential between the psychosocial and the medical paradigms of mental illness, rehabilitation, and recovery.
Students identify clients' individual needs, wants, choices, and preferences.
Students recognize the ethical, legal, and confidentiality issues that apply to the community mental health field.
Students use basic interviewing techniques and the active listening skills of empathy, compassion, and self-awareness.
Students utilize the DSM classification system, not as a diagnostic but as an assessment tool, to distinguish and assess abnormal behaviors.
